VENUSAUR-1.Pokedex: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

CHARIZARD-1.Pokedex: The overwhelming power that fills its entire body causes it to turn black and create intense blue flames.

CHARIZARD-2.Pokedex: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet fighter.

BLASTOISE-1.Pokedex: The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.

BEEDRILL-1.Pokedex: Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs, dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.

PIDGEOT-1.Pokedex: With its muscular strength now greatly increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks without resting.

RATTATA-1.Pokedex: With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and infiltrates people's homes. Then, with a twitch of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.

RATICATE-1.Pokedex: It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.

RAICHU-1.Pokedex: It uses psychokinesis to control electricity. It hops aboard its own tail, using psychic power to lift the tail and move about while riding it.

SANDSHREW-1.Pokedex: The skin on its back is as hard as steel. Predators go after its soft belly, so it clings to the ground desperately.

SANDSLASH-1.Pokedex: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

VULPIX-1.Pokedex: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

NINETALES-1.Pokedex: It lives on mountains perpetually covered in snow and is revered as a deity incarnate. It appears draped in a blizzard.

DIGLETT-1.Pokedex: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

DUGTRIO-1.Pokedex: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

MEOWTH-1.Pokedex: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

MEOWTH-2.Pokedex: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

PERSIAN-1.Pokedex: Its round face is a symbol of wealth. Persian that have bigger, plumper faces are considered more beautiful.

ALAKAZAM-1.Pokedex: Having traded away its muscles, Alakazam's true power has been unleashed. With its psychic powers, it can foresee all things.

GEODUDE-1.Pokedex: Geodude compete against each other with headbutts. The iron sand on their heads will stick to whichever one has stronger magnetism.

GRAVELER-1.Pokedex: They eat rocks and often get into a scrap over them. The shock of Graveler smashing together causes a flash of light and a booming noise.

GOLEM-1.Pokedex: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

PONYTA-1.Pokedex: Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few rubs from this Pokémon's horn, any slight wound you have will be healed.

RAPIDASH-1.Pokedex: Little can stand up to its psycho cut. Unleashed from this Pokémon's horn, the move will punch a hole right through a thick metal sheet.

SLOWPOKE-1.Pokedex: Although this Pokémon is normally zoned out, its expression abruptly sharpens on occasion. The cause for this seems to lie in Slowpoke's diet.

SLOWBRO-1.Pokedex: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

SLOWBRO-2.Pokedex: Having been swallowed whole by Shellder, Slowbro now has an iron defense. It's pretty comfortable in there, too.

FARFETCHD-1.Pokedex: The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the Galar region. Farfetch'd that adapted to these stalks took on a unique form.

GRIMER-1.Pokedex: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.

MUK-1.Pokedex: The garbage it eats causes continuous chemical changes in its body, which produce its exceedingly vivid coloration.

GENGAR-1.Pokedex: The energy of Mega Evolution awakened it. It sinks into another dimension, where it keeps a patient watch for its chance to attack.

EXEGGUTOR-1.Pokedex: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

MAROWAK-1.Pokedex: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

WEEZING-1.Pokedex: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

KANGASKHAN-1.Pokedex: The explosive energy the child is bathed in causes temporary growth. The mother is beside herself with worry about it.

MRMIME-1.Pokedex: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

PINSIR-1.Pokedex: It zips around at blistering speeds, looking for an opening to skewer its opponent on its giant pincers.

GYARADOS-1.Pokedex: It zooms out of the water at Mach speeds. Even large ships caught in its path are split cleanly in two!

AERODACTYL-1.Pokedex: When it Mega Evolves, it becomes more vicious than ever before. Some say that's because its excess of power is causing it pain.

ARTICUNO-1.Pokedex: Its feather-like blades are composed of psychic energy and can shear through thick iron sheets as if they were paper.

ZAPDOS-1.Pokedex: When its feathers rub together, they produce a crackling sound like the zapping of electricity. That's why this Pokémon is called Zapdos.

MOLTRES-1.Pokedex: This Pokémon's sinister, flame-like aura will consume the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims become burned-out shadows of themselves.

MEWTWO-1.Pokedex: Psychic power has augmented its muscles. It has a grip strength of one ton and can sprint a hundred meters in two seconds flat!

MEWTWO-2.Pokedex: Despite its diminished size, its mental power has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.

AMPHAROS-1.Pokedex: Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently awakening its long-sleeping dragon's blood.

SLOWKING-1.Pokedex: While chanting strange spells, this Pokémon combines its internal toxins with what it's eaten, creating strange potions.

SCIZOR-1.Pokedex: It's better at beating things than grasping them. When it battles for a long time, the weight of its pincers becomes too much to bear.

HERACROSS-1.Pokedex: A tremendous influx of energy builds it up, but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross is bothered by terrible soreness in its muscles.

CORSOLA-1.Pokedex: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others' life-force through its branches.

HOUNDOOM-1.Pokedex: Its red claws and the tips of its tail are melting from high internal temperatures that are painful to Houndoom itself.

TYRANITAR-1.Pokedex: Due to the colossal power poured into it, this Pokémon's back split right open. Its destructive instincts are the only thing keeping it moving.

ZIGZAGOON-1.Pokedex: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

LINOONE-1.Pokedex: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

SABLEYE-1.Pokedex: Supporting a giant heavy jewel, it can't change direction very nimbly and is vulnerable to attack from behind.

MAWILE-1.Pokedex: Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if they each had a will of their own. One gnash from them can turn a boulder to dust.

MANECTRIC-1.Pokedex: Too much electricity has built up in its body, irritating Manectric. Its explosive speed is equal to that of a lightning bolt.

SHARPEDO-1.Pokedex: The yellow patterns it bears are old scars. The energy from Mega Evolution runs through them, causing it sharp pain and suffering.

CASTFORM-1.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes on the brightest of days. Its skin is unexpectedly hot to the touch, so approach with care.

CASTFORM-2.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes when soaked with rain. When its body is compressed, water will seep out as if from a sponge.

CASTFORM-3.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes when covered in snow. Its body becomes an ice-like material, with a temperature near -5 degrees Celsius.

BANETTE-1.Pokedex: Extraordinary energy amplifies its cursing power to such an extent that it can't help but curse its own Trainer.

ABSOL-1.Pokedex: When this Pokémon whips the winglike fur on its back as though beating its wings, it sends an intimidating aura flying at its opponents.

GLALIE-1.Pokedex: It envelops prey in its mouth, freezing them instantly. But its jaw is dislocated, so it's unable to eat them.

SALAMENCE-1.Pokedex: It puts its forelegs inside its shell to streamline itself for flight. Salamence flies at high speeds over all kinds of topographical features.

METAGROSS-1.Pokedex: Its intellect surpasses its previous level, resulting in battles so cruel, they'll make you want to cover your eyes.

CHERRIM-1.Pokedex: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It's full of energy while it's like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

SHELLOS-1.Pokedex: Its appearance changes depending on the environment. One theory suggests that living in cold seas causes Shellos to take on this form.

GASTRODON-1.Pokedex: Its body is covered in a sticky slime. It's very susceptible to dehydration, so it can't spend too much time on land.

LOPUNNY-1.Pokedex: It swings its ears like whips and strikes its enemies with them. It has an intensely combative disposition.

GARCHOMP-1.Pokedex: Its vaunted wings become scythes, sending it mad with rage. It swings its scythes wildly and slices the ground to pieces.

LUCARIO-1.Pokedex: It readies itself to face its enemies by focusing its mental energies. Its fighting style can be summed up in a single word: heartless.

ROTOM-1.Pokedex: This Rotom has possessed a convection microwave oven that uses a special motor. It also has a flair for manipulating flames.

ROTOM-2.Pokedex: This form of Rotom enjoys coming up with water-based pranks. Be careful with it if you don't want your room flooded.

ROTOM-3.Pokedex: Rotom assumes this form when it takes over a refrigerator powered by a special motor. It battles by spewing cold air.

ROTOM-4.Pokedex: In this form, Rotom applies its new power over wind to its love of pranks. It will happily blow away any important documents it can find.

ROTOM-5.Pokedex: This is Rotom after it's seized control of a lawn mower that has a special motor. As it mows down grass, it scatters the clippings everywhere.

BASCULIN-1.Pokedex: Even Basculin, which devours everything it can with its huge jaws, is nothing more than food to organisms stronger than itself.

DARUMAKA-1.Pokedex: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

DARMANITAN-1.Pokedex: When wounded, it stops moving. It goes as still as stone to meditate, sharpening its mind and spirit.

DARMANITAN-2.Pokedex: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

DARMANITAN-3.Pokedex: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

YAMASK-1.Pokedex: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

STUNFISK-1.Pokedex: Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.

KYUREM-1.Pokedex: It has foreseen that a world of truth will arrive for people and Pokémon. It strives to protect that future.

KYUREM-2.Pokedex: It's said that this Pokémon battles in order to protect the ideal world that will exist in the future for people and Pokémon.

KELDEO-1.Pokedex: The power that lay hidden in its body now covers its horn, turning it into a sword that can slice through anything.

FLOETTE-5.Pokedex: The flower it's holding can no longer be found blooming anywhere. It's also thought to contain terrifying power.

MEOWSTIC-1.Pokedex: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

AEGISLASH-1.Pokedex: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

PUMPKABOO-1.Pokedex: Spirits that wander this world are placed into Pumpkaboo's body. They're then moved on to the afterlife.

PUMPKABOO-2.Pokedex: When taking spirits to the afterlife, large Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of adults to those of children.

PUMPKABOO-3.Pokedex: Massive Pumpkaboo are said to be the product of areas where a great number of lost souls lingered.

GOURGEIST-1.Pokedex: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

GOURGEIST-2.Pokedex: Large Gourgeist put on the guise of adults, taking the hands of children to lead them to the afterlife.

GOURGEIST-3.Pokedex: Supersized Gourgeist aren't picky. They will forcefully drag anyone off to the afterlife.

ZYGARDE-1.Pokedex: This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent's chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.

ZYGARDE-2.Pokedex: This is Zygarde's perfected form. From the orifice on its chest, it radiates high-powered energy that eliminates everything.

ORICORIO-1.Pokedex: It creates an electric charge by rubbing its feathers together. It dances over to its enemies and delivers shocking electrical punches.

ORICORIO-2.Pokedex: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

ORICORIO-3.Pokedex: It summons the dead with its dreamy dancing. From their malice, it draws power with which to curse its enemies.

LYCANROC-1.Pokedex: It goads its enemies into attacking, withstands the hits, and in return, delivers a headbutt, crushing their bones with its rocky mane.

LYCANROC-2.Pokedex: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

WISHIWASHI-1.Pokedex: Weak Wishiwashi school together to concentrate their power. Their united force makes them the demon of the sea, feared near and far.

MINIOR-7.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MINIOR-8.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MINIOR-9.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MINIOR-10.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MINIOR-11.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MINIOR-12.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MINIOR-13.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MIMIKYU-1.Pokedex: Sad that its true identity may be exposed, Mimikyu will mercilessly seek revenge on any opponent that breaks its neck.

NECROZMA-1.Pokedex: This is Necrozma's form while it's absorbing the power of Solgaleo, making it extremely ferocious and impossible to control.

NECROZMA-2.Pokedex: Lunala no longer has a will of its own. Now under the control of Necrozma, it continuously expels all of its energy.

NECROZMA-3.Pokedex: The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.

MAGEARNA-1.Pokedex: This gorgeous Magearna looks as it did at the time of its invention. Its luxurious decoration pleased the king's daughter.

CRAMORANT-1.Pokedex: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

CRAMORANT-2.Pokedex: This Cramorant has accidentally gotten a Pikachu lodged in its gullet. Cramorant is choking a little, but it isn't really bothered.

TOXTRICITY-1.Pokedex: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

SINISTEA-1.Pokedex: The swirl pattern in this Pokémon's body is its weakness. If it gets stirred, the swirl loses its shape, and Sinistea gets dizzy.

POLTEAGEIST-1.Pokedex: Trainers Polteageist trusts will be allowed to experience its distinctive flavor and aroma firsthand by sampling just a tiny bit of its tea.

ALCREMIE-1.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a sweet and tart flavor.

ALCREMIE-7.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a sweet and tart flavor.

ALCREMIE-14.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream an aromatic flavor.

ALCREMIE-21.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a refreshing flavor.

ALCREMIE-28.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a sour flavor.

ALCREMIE-35.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a salty flavor.

ALCREMIE-42.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a mixed flavor.

ALCREMIE-49.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a bitter flavor.

ALCREMIE-56.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a complex flavor.

EISCUE-1.Pokedex: The ice covering this Pokémon's face has shattered, revealing a slightly worried expression that many people are enamored with.

INDEEDEE-1.Pokedex: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

MORPEKO-1.Pokedex: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

ZACIAN-1.Pokedex: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

ZAMAZENTA-1.Pokedex: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

URSHIFU-1.Pokedex: It's believed that this Pokémon modeled its fighting style on the flow of a river—sometimes rapid, sometimes calm.

CALYREX-1.Pokedex: According to lore, this Pokémon showed no mercy to those who got in its way, yet it would heal its opponents' wounds after battle.

CALYREX-2.Pokedex: Legend says that by using its power to see all events from past to future, this Pokémon saved the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.
